question.text: The motion of a particle of mass m is described by y = (1/2)ut - (1/2)gt^2. Find the force acting on the particle.
question.ask: Find the force acting on the particle.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Write the given motion
steps.why: Start from y(t) so you can redo this first line.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Velocity is dy/dt
steps.why: Differentiate each term with the power rule.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Apply F = ma
steps.why: The minus sign means the force is downward.

try_yourself: Differentiate to get v, then a.
What does the minus sign in F tell you?
